Definition: an apparently primary word; a measure ("metre"), literally or figuratively; by implication, a limited portion (degree):-- measure.
BiblicalUsage: With what measure you mete it shall be measured to you again, God gives not the Spirit by measure to His Son, and grace is given to each of us according to the measure of the gift of Christ. The word is the standard itself, and Scripture uses it for judgment, for the Spirit, and for grace.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the measure of grace is the verse that settles the question: Christ gives as He wills, and every one of us has received according to the measure of His gift, not according to our deserving. Every one of us has received according to the measure of His gift, not according to our deserving.
